compiled_state.author: Test
compiled_state.description:
## Incident Overview
Scenario Type: Sub-Agent Blocker

### Expected
The link relation grammar is `depends_on | blocks | relates_to | duplicates | supersedes` (ticket-cli-reference.md). An unknown relation like `blocked_by` should be rejected (or normalized to the reverse `blocks`).

### Actual
`ticket link <src> <tgt> blocked_by` is ACCEPTED and stored verbatim as a `blocked_by` dependency. Evidence: 0734-6880-76be-425e shows ('blocked_by','588e-abec') in its deps. A non-canonical relation in the store may not be honored by blocking/next-batch/ready/completion-verifier logic (silent mis-gating), and contradicts the grammar the docs + tooling assume.
